'''Esyam''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of molten rock that was located within the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region. The planet occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Y'Toub]], and lay on the junction of four [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] called the [[Oktos Route]], the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']], and the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']].

==Description==
Esyam was a molten rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region. The planet occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Y'Toub]], and lay on the junction of four [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] called the [[Oktos Route]], the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']], and the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']]. The Oktos Route connected Esyam to the planet of [[Kleeva]] while the ''Ootmian Pabol'' linked the planet to the world of [[Du Hutta]]. In addition to that, the routes of ''Pabol Hutta'' and ''Shag Pabol'' joined Esyam with the planets of [[Hosko]] and [[Rorak 4]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The territory surrounding Esyam had come under the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] approximately by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and was considered well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Esyam was first pictured in the entry for the planet of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. Esyam was depicted in a schematic of the Y'Toub system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Esyam's name was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published on [[August 18]], [[2009]]&mdash;which placed the planet in grid square S-12.
